aion-labs/aion-3.5.description: Recommended default - the model every request example on Aion Labs' own quickstart page (https://www.aionlabs.ai/docs/quickstart/, retrieved 2026-09-29) uses, in JavaScript, Python and curl alike, and released 2026-09-23, the latest release date on the roster (shared with Aion 3.5 Mini). Vendor-described as a multi-model system built on the GLM family, described for stronger narrative structure, tension and conflict, and mature or darker themes (https://www.aionlabs.ai/docs/models/); the vendor homepage describes its API as for creative writing, roleplay, research and production workloads (https://www.aionlabs.ai/). Context 262,144 tokens, max completion 32,768 and modality text->text on the unauthenticated GET /v1/models roster (2026-09-29); $3.00 / $6.00 per MTok input/output, $0.75 cached-input read on the docs models page (https://www.aionlabs.ai/docs/models/, retrieved 2026-09-29). Reasoning cannot be disabled on this model: reasoning_effort accepts only low, high (default) or max, and reasoning tokens share the max_tokens budget (https://www.aionlabs.ai/docs/api-reference/).

Roster-listed only, not called. Context 262,144, max completion 32,768, text->text on the unauthenticated GET /v1/models roster (2026-09-29); $0.70 / $1.40 per MTok input/output, $0.18 cached-input read on https://www.aionlabs.ai/docs/models/ (retrieved 2026-09-29). Reasoning cannot be disabled (reasoning_effort accepts only low, high or max per https://www.aionlabs.ai/docs/api-reference/). Fallback.

errorRules.message: Aion Labs usage limit exceeded (429 rate_limit_error). Free-tier accounts are limited to 15 requests/min, 20,000 tokens/min and 20,000 tokens/day; limits rise with lifetime credit top-ups - see https://www.aionlabs.ai/docs/rate-limits/

instructions: 1. Visit: https://www.aionlabs.ai/accounts/signup/ and sign up (GitHub, Google or email)
2. Create an API key from the dashboard's API keys page (https://www.aionlabs.ai/app/api-keys/, sign-in required) and copy it when it is shown

3. Free tier: the pricing page (https://www.aionlabs.ai/pricing/) offers a daily credit allowance with no card required; free-tier limits are 15 requests/min, 20,000 tokens/min and 20,000 tokens/day (https://www.aionlabs.ai/docs/rate-limits/)
setup.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://api.aionlabs.ai/v1 (https://www.aionlabs.ai/docs/), serving a six-model Aion roster; the vendor homepage describes the API as for creative writing, roleplay, research and production workloads (https://www.aionlabs.ai/). Documented errors share one envelope, {"error":{"message","type"}}, with 400 invalid_request_error, 429 rate_limit_error and 502 server_error (https://www.aionlabs.ai/docs/api-reference/). The docs give no 401 body and none was probed without a credential, so the errorRules carry only the documented 429; auth failures use the default classifier. Non-streaming responses must finish within 125 seconds or the edge returns HTTP 524, so prefer streaming for long or reasoning-heavy requests.

rosterVerified.method: unauthenticated GET https://api.aionlabs.ai/v1/models — 6 models; credential-free, no key used
